title: Developer Experience Update (3/3) -- Evolution
body:
Hello everyone!
It's been a while since our last update, this is a pretty large one, but there's a lot of good information, so I recommend reading this thoroughly.

We’re beginning to find our stride, and we’re currently moving with the bull market. To be able to sustain the growth we’re currently experiencing, as a community over the next month it’s really important to begin coming together and notating similar parallels across all different working groups, and how Edgeware will fulfill the missions for all of them. 

We want to ask ourselves the following questions: 

**how should the Edgeware network continue to expand and develop over the next 5 years given our current state? How will our new roadmap begin aligning with newly emerging technologies, and how will we ensure our scope is large enough that we are not cutting ourselves short.** It’s important to understand exactly what Edgeware is capable of right now, and then we can begin to strategize the necessary tools/suites designed to best align with what the DAO believes Edgeware needs. 

Currently, development efforts are focused on our EVM documentation, and support guides for building and troubleshooting in different Ethereum environments with Edgeware in preparation for our WAKO upgrade. Additionally, we are providing more instruction and guides for building within Substrate, so teams looking to build on top of Edgeware are familiar with how the whole tech stack works.

**Cohorts**
Edgeware will begin having a class every 2 that falls on the off-week for the EDG developers call starting the 16th of November. The goal is to teach ambitious individuals that are interested in learning more about blockchain technology, and a way for groups of learners to interact and build with each other. 

This would emerge within our EDG students Working Group, and begin to lay the foundations for a more ‘formal scholar’ system on Edgeware. Tentative meeting times would be 2-hour sessions, twice a month, and cover the like
